The warehouse loader requires tab-delimited files (TSV), and the reporter requests adding TSV as an export option alongside CSV and XLSX. This would avoid manual conversion errors when transaction descriptions contain commas.

input.title: Add TSV export support to the reports endpoint
input.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

The reports endpoint currently supports CSV and XLSX export formats but lacks TSV support. Since the warehouse loader requires tab-delimited files, adding TSV export would eliminate manual conversion errors caused by commas in transaction descriptions. The change should extend the `renderExport` function to handle TSV formatting, alongside CSV and XLSX, and update the `SUPPORTED_FORMATS` enum to include 'tsv'.
